scope: read-only review of final PR309 scientific report, PR309 Problem Definition section and compact evidence README against frozen source/run/analysis receipts; no builds, tests, model runs or edits by reviewer
reviewed_claims: Both tolerance-controlled runs use the same h pair, input and executable/source/archive pins; each completes 60 seconds with 64/128 accepted macrosteps and zero failures.

The official t=60 V3 published-FP32-to-FP64 screen has six passing rows; W RMS 1.79844365e-6 m/s is 0.6922 of the unchanged epsilon/3 limit. Scope is only the fixed named-case screen at t=60, not reference qualification or project-wide accuracy.
The internal W pair has 65 exact common times; max RMS difference is at t=56.25 s and the fixed fallback detail interval is [59.0625,60] s because there was no trigger crossing.

Newton count 2 is clarified as initial residual check plus one correction; max residual values and direct-local residual accounting are separately labeled. The residual sum is not a propagated state-error bound.
Stock RK3 comparison is correctly secondary under a different filter policy; no new RK3 run, 120-240 s run, frequency/phase, speed, or truth-error claim is made.
Small repository README recomputes compact NPZ arrays offline; no new production source or general CLI was added. Existing pressure/CF closures are explicitly not reopened.
limits: Only the new 60 s tolerance-controlled pair is assessed; 120/180/240 s and full reference eligibility remain open.
No true-error bound, global tolerance adoption, causal frequency or phase finding, or performance conclusion is made.
